reason: B proposes a specific, testable HEO overlayer that plausibly combines oxygen-mobility/low-temperature activity with physical anchoring against sintering, and defines quantitative exhaust, hydrothermal-aging, and microscopy comparisons while extending prior HEO results to a multi-principal-element alloy. A relies on insufficiently supported Pd segregation and assumes that Pd enrichment will simultaneously improve poisoning resistance and durability, although segregation could be unstable under cycling and may undermine the HEA surface.
